research.name: Joly UI
research.note: A free shadcn/ui registry of about 50 React components, mostly buttons, inputs and text animations.
unverified: The component source is public at github.com/Johuniq/jolyui (MIT, 268 stars); that repository has not yet been researched as a repo candidate.
The Liquid Metal Button builds on the @paper-design/shaders package rather than an effect of its own, which is why no signature effect is recorded.
